long_biography.plain_text:
At Kingsley Management Corporation, Conley Nate Nelson combines executive administration with residential-property operations. As president, director and secretary of the Provo-based company, he has helped oversee a manufactured-home community portfolio spanning several states. He also holds chief financial officer responsibilities within affiliated property operations.

Nelson's work extends beyond the head office. He has represented community businesses in property acquisitions and has served as president or administrative contact for regulated water and pipeline systems in Texas. At those properties, his duties have included presidency, financial direction and administrative responsibility for community water and pipeline systems.
